video_generation_prompt: Ultra-premium CGI commercial for Nestlé NAN COMFOR Família Comfor. Camera remains perfectly still throughout the 5-second scene, locked frontal, 70mm equivalent. Seamless first-to-last frame interpolation starting exactly as FRAME-1 and ending exactly as FRAME-2. STRICT BRAND PRESERVATION: preserve exact NAN COMFOR package geometry, proportions, scale, label placement, typography, magenta-to-purple gradient background, and the exact reference bird from packaging artwork: flat white silhouette body, deep magenta-burgundy outline contour lines, long pointed sharp beak, stylized curved head crest, rounded compact chest, broad angular wings with deep magenta edging, elegant tail at every frame. TIMELINE: 0.00-0.60s: empty magenta space activates with slow-moving technological lines, connected molecular points and subtle pulses of light. 0.60-1.25s: polished vortex of natural white milk expands upward from the base, with soft liquid ribbons wrapping around floating representations of vitamins, probiotics and nucleotides. 1.25-1.80s: rear-left NAN COMFOR can rises through the milk and settles, label fully legible. 1.80-2.35s: rear-right NAN COMFOR can follows through a second liquid opening. 2.35-2.95s: front central NAN COMFOR can emerges last, centered and dominant, while milk forms smooth circular cradle beneath all three products. 2.95-3.65s: exact reference bird ascends from behind the camera — broad white wing with deep magenta edging sweeps very close across the lens, revealing pointed beak, curved head crest, rounded breast and elegant tail before it lands inside the central can. 3.65-4.25s: side cans move subtly outward as molecular lights orbit around the group. 4.25-5.00s: seal appears from focused bloom of light and fine sparkling particles, reinforcing clean impression of advanced nutrition, precision and innovation, resolving exactly into FRAME-2. No subtitles. No text overlay.
